I will familiarize my self more with her campaign but U Knock on 9,455 doors u are meeting voters where they are and telling them u care about representing them.  Well done.  Bravo


Ruwa Romman (@ruwaromman)

We won this race by 374 votes. Our teams knocked 9,455 doors with a 23% contact rate. This is proof field still matters. 

For context, state was 62% Republican for these runoffs (they had more contentious races and millions dumped in) and Gwinnett County was 58% Republican. We bucked stat
